chunks.sectionTitle: To Find One or More Missing Terms
chunks.content:
6.10 To Find One or More Missing Terms
When one or more values of y   f (x) corresponding to the
equidistant values of x are missing, we can find these using any of
the following two methods:
First method: We assume the missing term or terms as a, b etc. and form
the difference table. Assuming the last difference as zero, we solve these
equations for a, b. These give the missing term/terms.
